_comment: v2 pretrain (443M decoder) on A100 40GB, bf16 + FLA. 4x2048x12 = 98k tokens/step x 90k steps ≈ 8.9B tokens (≈1 epoch of corpus_v6, Chinchilla for 443M). WSD schedule: flat LR, then the last 15% of steps decay on anneal.bin (prepare_data.py --mix anneal). Spans many sessions: resume from the HF backup. OOM → lower batch_size, raise grad_accum (keep the product).
